svg.title: Think better with Reflect
svg.desc: The reflect.app hero redrawn in SVG: a header, the headline and calls to action, a violet black hole with turning orbits and drifting stars, and the app window seen through frosted glass.

g.text: An open-source note-taking app with daily notes, backlinks, and local
Free on Mac. Paid subscription on iPhone and iPad.
A note-taking tool designed to mirror the way we think
Our brains remember things through associations. Reflect mimics this
by backlinking notes to each other (read more on backlinking here).
Over time, this gives you superhuman recall skills. Reflect becomes an
What should I record within Reflect?
To-do and Top of Mind lists
Save clips from the web or your Kindle
We recommend you splitting your personal and work notes into two graphs.
